wishes.intro: Not great with words or long speeches, so I let my lines of code speak...
wishes.body: Happy birthday Talia, I hope you'll spend an amazing day with your loved ones. I don't regret getting to know you — you brought so much more to camp than what you were paid for. You brought joy, peace, good vibes, and so much more. Enjoy your day.
wishes.outro: And click the button below to see your little tiny gift.

letters.T: Talia — the day we met, we had no idea how much it would shape our summer.
letters.A1: Along the way, your joy, humor and kindness naturally brought people together.
letters.L: Listening — the kids found in you someone who truly heard them and always brought a little light.
letters.I: In everything — your music, your laughter, your talents, your wisdom, but above all your deeply human way with others.
letters.A2: And today, thinking back on that summer, we don't just remember the activities or the days spent together: we remember Talia, and the difference you made in our lives.

kennedy.title: Happy Birthday Kennedy !
kennedy.joke: I always regret that it's not you in the picture... 😂

bubble.main: Your biggest fear is being forgotten by your loved ones?... Trust me, we've been trying to, but someone as kind, loving and warm as you doesn't make it easy. You create memories so effortlessly with those you love, and that's something we're not about to forget.
bubble.ps: PS: This is the moment you say "That's soooo cute" with you-know-who's accent. 😄
